institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Manual harvesting and spraying of tall plantation crops like coconut or arecanut palms involve severe tree-fall injury risks and suffer from acute seasonal labor shortages.
description: A bio-inspired autonomous tree-climbing robot chassis engineered with a split-ring structural guide clamp, an array of radially contracting pneumatic artificial muscles, twin dual-rod pneumatic cylinders, and an integrated wireless camera payload deck.
applications: Automated coconut harvesting rigs, high-wire plantation pesticide spraying operations, forestry health telemetry tracking, and smart orchard yield analysis.
secondary_sector: Agribusiness & Rural Economy, Digital Technologies, AI & Software
